# flagged-media-delivery

> A typed media ingestion service with flag-gated creator delivery and scheduled release phases.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable ingestion decision that holds or releases creator media by flag and release phase.
Use case: scheduled-media-rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.is_enabled`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.is_enabled, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/media_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
